title: Two-Spark inference and a clearer Cloudless Agent
summary: CloudlessOS 0.2.2 turns paired DGX Sparks into a managed distributed inference system, improves model-loading visibility, and completes the Hermes-powered assistant experience.
changes: Connect, verify, manage, and safely disconnect two DGX Sparks from a guided CloudlessOS interface built into the DGX Dashboard.
Run supported models across both Sparks through a managed Ray and vLLM topology, with peer GPU and unified-memory visibility on the Cloudless desktop.
Report distributed model startup accurately by distinguishing the peer download, peer weight loading, checkpoint loading, inference optimization, and ready stages.
Show real model download bytes, percentage, and an estimated remaining time instead of holding the interface at a synthetic 92 percent.
Protect cluster removal by stopping distributed inference first, removing the private fabric safely, and returning the system to a compatible local model.
Allow the Cloudless virtual keyboard to type into focused controls inside embedded dashboards without leaving the CloudlessOS experience.
Identify Ask Cloudless and the Cloudless Agent consistently as powered by Hermes Agent.
Harden multi-architecture release baseline recovery so AMD64 and ARM64 package generations remain signed, isolated, and reproducible.
